sections.name: Action Safety Rules
sections.body: Safe actions run directly. Medium-risk actions require an approval code. High-risk actions are blocked until explicitly enabled. Secrets are never displayed; only configured/missing status is shown.

sections.name: Nightly Build Process
sections.body: Nightly Build → Testing → Feedback → Fix → Promote to Core Feature. Experimental work must be registered here before promotion.

sections.name: Integrated Services
sections.body: Mission Control integrates Hermes Dashboard, Hermes WebUI, Claw3D, Claw3D Adapter, and its own control API. Embeds are a bridge; native panels become the final interface.

sections.name: Rollback
sections.body: Rollback baseline exists in git. Run: cd /root/mission-control && git reset --hard HEAD && systemctl restart mission-control.service.
